c74object.name: evi_crossover_sum
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Summing, including allpass alignment, for use with evi.crossover.3band~
c74object.description:
evi_crossover_sum is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_crossover_sum.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_crossover_sum is also available in MSP as: evi.crossover.sum~.
Linkwitz-Riley crossovers sum perfectly flat on recombination of the outputs (providing allpass alignment is used). Use evi.crossover.sum~ to sum multiband processing created with the evi.crossover.3band~ object. @see the 'seealso' section for other evieve objects that are related.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ low, mid, high, high } }

geninlet.name: high
geninlet.digest: Crossover Frequency in Hz @min 10 @max 20000. Allpass alignment requires feeding in the 'High Crossover Frequency' from the [evi.crossover.3band~] object in order to produce the correct signal.

attribute.name: align
attribute.description: Allpass alignment in this splitting stage off or on. This must be opposite to the equivalent attribute in the feeding [evi.crossover.3band~] object. @see 'Discussion' in the reference file for more information.

attribute.name: order
attribute.description: 0=2-pole (shallower) crossover filters, 1=4-pole (steeper) crossover filters. 2-pole can be subtle, 4-pole gives more rejection. This must be matched with the equivalent attribute in the feeding [evi.crossover.3band~] object.
